item.title: Valkey and the Hidden Foundations of the Digital Enterprise
item.description:
Customers rarely think about the infrastructure supporting their digital experiences. A mobile subscriber expects account information to appear promptly and a retailer needs transactions to complete without disruption. Few consider ...

Customers rarely think about the infrastructure supporting their digital experiences. A mobile subscriber expects account information to appear promptly and a retailer needs transactions to complete without disruption. Few consider the databases, caches and other software components working behind the scenes. Yet when those foundations struggle, the consequences become very visible indeed.

item.title: Can Google Move Beyond the Chromebook?
item.description:
Google has spent years building its laptop business on Chromebooks: relatively affordable devices designed largely around web-based apps and services. In May 2026, the company announced Googlebook, a new category ...

Google has spent years building its laptop business on Chromebooks: relatively affordable devices designed largely around web-based apps and services. In May 2026, the company announced Googlebook, a new category of laptops that brings together Android technology, features from ChromeOS and Google’s Gemini AI. The first models, made by Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo, went on sale in selected markets in October.

item.title: India Mobile Congress 2026: From Smartphones to Wearables and Semiconductors
item.description:
From 7 to 10 October, India hosted the 10th edition of India Mobile Congress (IMC) in New Delhi. As in previous years, the event reflected a gradual shift away from ...

From 7 to 10 October, India hosted the 10th edition of India Mobile Congress (IMC) in New Delhi. As in previous years, the event reflected a gradual shift away from smartphones to a broader set of technology products. At the 2025 event, Samsung was the only major smartphone-maker to maintain a dedicated booth. This year, even Samsung was absent.

UK operators EE and VodafoneThree both recently unveiled priority mobile services for consumer customers. In each case, their aim is to bolster spending and drive a better return on network investment amid enduring industry struggles to find new sources of growth.

item.title: How SpaceX Will Launch a Mobile Network
item.description:

On SpaceX’s earning call, CEO Elon Musk discussed the company becoming a mobile network operator in the US. To date, Starlink’s satellite connectivity has provided fixed broadband services that are mainly used in areas without good fibre broadband, and a messaging service for smartphones as a back-up if terrestrial connectivity is unavailable or not working.
